WITH base_candidates AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants
  WHERE brand = 'Sormat'
    AND (series = 'Universal S-KA GGR-F8A' OR model = 'Universal S-KA GGR-F8A' OR product_name LIKE '%Universal S-KA GGR-F8A%')
),
matched_props AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM base_candidates pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku
  WHERE (pvp.property_key = 'anchor_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'frame fixing')
     OR (pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '8 mm')
     OR (pvp.property_key = 'length' AND pvp.property_value_text = '60 mm')
     OR (pvp.property_key = 'pack_count' AND pvp.property_value_text = '100 pcs')
  GROUP BY pv.product_sku
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pvp.property_key) = 4
)
SELECT mp.product_sku, mp.record_path,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = mp.product_sku AND property_key = 'length' AND property_value_text = '50 mm') AS extra_claim_present
FROM matched_props mp
LIMIT 1;
